meaning: Approximate source display footprint, not sovereign territory or independently reviewed historical area.
methodology: Offline longitude-unwrapped polygon union removes overlapping/duplicate parts; GeographicLib 2.2.0 WGS84 geodesic exterior area minus holes. Input is the complete untiled retained display product, including its existing Mercator polar limit. Ring winding that cannot be represented unambiguously is unavailable. Rounded to whole square kilometres; source precision is much coarser. Regional rows cover only the Isles/Channel clipping window. No runtime intersections or population inference.
